title: Prince Edward
summary: Raleigh names Prince Edward in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Prince Edward, named in Fortescue his discourse. Not Edward the Fourth, and not Edward the Sixth. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IV, §. XVI, sig. 198b–199a
